## Admissions Process

Follow these simple steps to begin your journey at RV University:

###### Step 01

###### Register Yourself

Create your account on the RV University admissions portal using your basic details.

###### Step 02

###### Verify Your Email

Check your inbox and verify your email ID to activate your account.

###### Step 03

###### Start Your Application

Log in and begin filling in the application form with your academic details, personal information, and programme preferences.

###### Step 04

###### Pay the Application Fee

Proceed to pay the application fee online through the secure payment gateway.

###### Step 05

###### Complete and Submit

Review all the information entered, upload the required documents, and submit your application.

Once submitted, our admissions team will reach out with further steps regarding interviews or assessments, if applicable.

## Message from Director

#### Dr.(H.C.) A.V.S. Murthy

##### Director-Admission & Outreach, RV University

**Dear Future RVians**

Welcome to RV University – where aspirations meet opportunities and potential transforms into achievement. At RVU, we are committed to nurturing talent and empowering young minds to become leaders of tomorrow. With a strong foundation built on academic excellence, innovative learning, and a vibrant campus life, our aim is to provide students not just with degrees but with meaningful experiences that shape their future.

We believe every student has a unique journey, and it is our privilege to guide and support you throughout this transformative phase. Whether your passion lies in engineering, arts, business, design, law, or science, RV University offers programs that blend academic rigor with practical exposure, preparing you for a dynamic and evolving world.

Our admissions team is here to assist you every step of the way – from understanding your course options to navigating the application process. We encourage you to explore the various facets of our university, interact with faculty, and reach out with any questions.

I invite you to join us on this exciting journey and become part of a community that thrives on curiosity, creativity, and innovation. Together, let’s build a future of endless possibilities.

Looking forward to welcoming you to RV University!

RV University welcomes students from across the world to be part of its diverse and vibrant academic community. International students benefit from globally aligned curricula, strong academic support and opportunities for interdisciplinary learning.The University offers dedicated support for admissions, visas, accommodation and cultural integration, enabling students to transition smoothly into campus life and academic engagement in India’s innovation capital, Bengaluru.

text: ## Financial Aid & Support At RV University, we believe that financial circumstances should never stand between a student and an exceptional education. Our financial aid framework is designed to recognise merit and ensure that the right support reaches those who need it — at every stage of your academic journey. #### Scholarship for Children of RVEI Staff RV University offers an annual scholarship of Rs. 25,000 to children of full-time employees of Rashtreeya Vidyalaya Educational Institutions (RVEI), including RV University and RVCE. This scholarship is renewable each year, subject to the continuation of the parent’s employment and the student’s satisfactory academic and disciplinary record. ## Cancellation and Refund Policy

For the AY 2026-27 as per UGC guidelines letter dated 15 August 2026, Ref. No. D.O.No.F.12-5/2024 (FNT/NET), the cancelation and refund dates of RV University are listed below.

#### UG & PG Programmes 2026-27

| **Date of Application for Cancellation** | **Percentage of Refund from First Year Full Fees** |
| --- | --- |
| Before 15 August 2026 | 100 % Refund |
| Between 16 August 2026 to 30 August 2026 | 90 % Refund |
| Between 31 August 2026 to 15 September 2026 | 80 % Refund |
| Between 16 September 2026 to 30 September 2026 | 50 % Refund |
| After 1 October 2026 | 0 % Refund |

* In case the admission of the student is cancelled on account of disciplinary action or violation of Anti Ragging Regulations or breach of code of conduct or any other Rules and Regulations of the University, no refund of fees is permissible.
* Entrance Examinations Fees / Application Form Fees are non – refundable.
* In any other case which is not covered in the above Rules, the decision would be taken by the Vice Chancellor.
* Under the circumstance of cancellation because of any disciplinary action no refund will be paid against any Academic and/ or Hostel and/ or Other Fees.

title: RVU Placement Policy Quick Reference 2027
text: PLACEMENT POLICY – QUICK REFERENCE (2027) a) This document is a summary for quick understanding. b) The Detailed RV University Placement Policy (2026) is the sole authoritative and binding document. c) In case of any difference, interpretation, or future modification, the Detailed Policy shall prevail. d) acknowledgement confirming that he/she has understood its contents and agrees to abide by all provisions stated herein, as well as those detailed in the comprehensive RV University Placement Policy (2026). 1. PLACEMENT GOVERNANCE ● Career & Alumni Relations (CAR) coordinates all placement and internship activities across Schools. ● CAR facilitates processes but does not adjudicate disciplinary matters. ● All placement-related violations are formally referred to the Student Disciplinary Committee (STDC) under the University’s Student Code of Conduct. 2. STUDENT ELIGIBILITY (SUMMARY) A student may participate in placements only if all the following are satisfied: ● No academic backlogs at the time of registering for placement drives (unless permitted by a recruiter). ● Minimum 80% attendance in mandatory pre-placement training. ● Submission of the Placement Registration & Declaration Form. ● Completion of required experiential components (internship / immersion / capstone), unless exceptionally approved by School leadership. ● Compliance with all company-specific eligibility criteria. ● No pending disciplinary case with STDC. 3. PRE-PLACEMENT TRAINING (MANDATORY) Training consists of: 1. Domain / Technical Training (School-specific) 2. Soft Skills Training 3. Emotional, Behaviour & Networking Intelligence Training Minimum 80% attendance across all components is compulsory. Any restriction due to non-compliance is decided by the Dean of the School, in consultation with CAR. 4. It becomes applicable only when: ●

OFFER RULES – KEY POINTS 4.1 One Offer Rule (1×) ● A student is considered placed (1×) once their name appears in a recruiter’s final selection list, irrespective of acceptance or rejection. 4.2 Offer Progression Rule (1.5×) — ACTIVATION CONDITION The 1.5× opportunity is not automatic. It becomes applicable only when: ● At least 40% of eligible students of the concerned School are placed, OR ● The Dean of the School formally announces activation, whichever is earlier. Until activation: ● Students are expected to apply carefully and responsibly. ● Participation in higher-value opportunities is governed by institutional discretion and fairness. Once activated: ● A student may attend up to four (4) additional placement drives, provided: o Existing offer CTC is below ₹8 LPA, and o The new offer is at least 1.5× the current offer. After exhausting this progression, eligibility shifts only to Dream Offer opportunities. 4.3 Maximum Placement Opportunities ● A student shall be provided a maximum of five notified (5) placement opportunities/attempts facilitated by RV University during a placement cycle. ● At the Dean’s discretion, up to two additional opportunities may be provided once 40% of eligible students of the School are placed, in consultation with CAR. ● Dream Company Opportunities, if declared by the Dean in consultation with CAR, may be exempted from this limit. 5. DREAM OFFER – CONCEPT ● A Dream Offer is an offer significantly higher than the historical highest CTC achieved by the School. ● The benchmark is dynamic, progressive, and School-specific. Illustration: If a School’s historical highest CTC is ₹30 LPA and a later offer of ₹35 LPA is received, the Dream Offer benchmark thereafter stands revised to ₹35 LPA or higher for subsequent opportunities. 6. STUDENT RESPONSIBILITIES ● Apply only to roles and organisations the student is genuinely willing

title: RVU Examination Policy
text: 1 RV University Manual of Examination Rules and Regulations 1. Introduction This manual defines the terms and roles, policies, and processes, as well as the rules related to the assessments at RV University. This applies to all existing schools and departments of RV University. It will also be applicable to schools and departments that will be established in the future. A variety of assessment methods that are appropriate to a given discipline/subject area and programme of study will be used to assess progress towards the course/programme learning outcomes. Assessment of student performance will be divided into two parts: (1) Continuous Internal Evaluation (CIE) and (2) Semester End Evaluation (SEE). CIE will consist of class tests, mid-semester examination(s), homework assignments, etc., as determined by the faculty in charge of the courses of study. Progress towards achievement of learning outcomes will be assessed using the following: time-constrained examinations; closed-book and open-book tests; problem-based assignments; practical assignment, laboratory reports; observation of practical skills; individual project reports (case-study reports); team project reports; oral presentations, including seminar presentation; viva voce interviews; computerized adaptive assessment, examination on demand, modular certifications, etc. Quality and rigor of education at any University largely depends on the flawless policies and processes of assessment. This manual, therefore, makes every attempt to maintain the high- level academic quality and rigor of education at the RV University by evolving flawless policies and regulations. A. This `Manual of Examination Rules and Regulations’ is subject to approval by the Board of Examinations, the Academic Council, and the Board of Management of the RV University. B. This manual of examination regulations is developed to ensure fair, accurate and efficient evaluation methods, keeping in mind the need for transparency and academic integrity. C. The manual is applicable to all the programmes and courses of all the schools and departments of RV University. D. This

title: RVU UGC Proforma
text:
RV University - UGC Proforma Academic Policies

Assessment Framework:
- Continuous Internal Evaluation (CIE): 70% weightage
- Semester End Examination (SEE): 30% weightage
- UG pass requirement: Above 40% in both CIE and SEE
- PG pass requirement: Above 50% in both CIE and SEE
- Students must maintain 80% attendance in every course

Progression Policy:
- Students with FI (Failed in Internals) or SA (Shortage of Attendance) may register in summer semester
- Maximum 12 credits or 4 courses (whichever is minimum) in summer semester
- A student must earn 80% of total credits in an academic year to be promoted to the next year

Fee Structure (set by Fee Regulatory Committee and Board of Governors):
- B.Tech (AIML, Data Science, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity): CET seats as per GOK; JEE Mains ₹5,00,000/yr; MQ ₹10,00,000/yr
- B.Sc Economics: ₹1,20,000/yr + ₹16,000 skill/exam fees
- BBA: ₹2,25,000–₹2,50,000/yr + ₹16,000
- MBA: ₹5,50,000–₹6,25,000/yr + ₹16,000

Schools at RV University:
- School of Liberal Arts & Sciences (SOLAS)
- School of Design & Innovation (SODI)
- School of Economics and Public Policy (SOE)
- School of Business (SOB)
- School of Computer Science and Engineering (SOCSE)
- School of Law (SOL)
- School of Film, Media and Creative Arts (SOFMCA)
- School of Continuing Education and Professional Studies (SCEPS)
- School of Allied and Healthcare Professions (SOAHP)
